name: bonk-game-dev
description: Tools for the browser client: linting (eslint), the browser tests (playwright) and planck.js (the browser's copy of the physics, served from bonk_game/server/static/vendor: `npm run vendor` copies it there after an update).

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/planck/dist/planck.min.js node_modules/planck/LICENSE.txt bonk_game/server/static/vendor/ && mv bonk_game/server/static/vendor/LICENSE.txt bonk_game/server/static/vendor/planck.LICENSE && gzip -9kfn bonk_game/server/static/vendor/planck.min.js
